<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>PNGRB B.1 — Hydrogen Blending Pipeline Screening Tool</title>
<style>
:root{
color-scheme: light;
--surface-1:#fcfcfb; --plane:#f2f2ee; --card:#ffffff;
--text-primary:#0b0b0b; --text-secondary:#52514e; --muted:#898781;
--grid:#e1e0d9; --axis:#c3c2b7; --border:rgba(11,11,11,0.10);
--good:#0ca30c; --warning:#fab219; --serious:#ec835a; --critical:#d03b3b;
--accent:#2a78d6; --accent-soft:#cde2fb;
--shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,11,11,.05), 0 4px 14px rgba(11,11,11,.05);
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
color-scheme: dark;
--surface-1:#1a1a19; --plane:#0d0d0d; --card:#1f1f1e;
--text-primary:#ffffff; --text-secondary:#c3c2b7; --muted:#898781;
--grid:#2c2c2a; --axis:#383835; --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
--good:#0ca30c; --warning:#fab219; --serious:#ec835a; --critical:#d03b3b;
--accent:#3987e5; --accent-soft:#184f95;
--shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{
margin:0; background:var(--plane); color:var(--text-primary);
font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:14px; line-height:1.5;
}
header.top{
background:var(--surface-1); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
padding:14px 22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;
position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
}
header.top h1{font-size:16px; margin:0; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.01em}
header.top .sub{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:2px}
.spacer{flex:1}
button, select, input{font-family:inherit; font-size:13px}
.btn{
background:var(--card); color:var(--text-primary); border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:7px; padding:7px 12px; cursor:pointer; transition:.12s;
}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn.primary:hover{opacity:.9; color:#fff}
.btn.sm{padding:4px 9px; font-size:12px; border-radius:6px}
.wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 440px; gap:20px; padding:20px; align-items:start; max-width:1560px; margin:0 auto}
@media (max-width:1180px){ .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr} .results{position:static !important} }
.card{
background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px;
margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden;
}
.card > .head{
display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 16px; cursor:pointer;
border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
}
.card.open > .head{border-bottom-color:var(--border)}
.card .head .num{
width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent);
display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; flex:none;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card .head .num{color:#fff}
.card .head h2{font-size:14px; margin:0; font-weight:620; flex:1}
.card .head .wt{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; background:var(--plane); padding:2px 7px; border-radius:20px; border:1px solid var(--border)}
.card .head .mini{font-size:12px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:650; min-width:34px; text-align:right}
.card .head .chev{color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; transition:.15s; transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.card.open .head .chev{transform:rotate(0)}
.card .body{display:none; padding:14px 16px 16px}
.card.open .body{display:block}
.note{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin:0 0 12px; padding-left:10px; border-left:2px solid var(--grid)}
.field{margin-bottom:11px}
.field label{display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:520}
.field .hint{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px}
input[type=number], input[type=text], select{
width:100%; padding:7px 9px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px;
background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text-primary);
}
input:focus, select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:-1px}
.row{display:grid; gap:10px}
.row.c2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.row.c3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}
.row.c4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr}
@media(max-width:640px){.row.c2,.row.c3,.row.c4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.seg{display:inline-flex; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:10px}
.seg button{background:var(--surface-1); border:0; padding:6px 12px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:12px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--accent); color:#fff}
.itemlist{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px}
.item{
display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1.3fr 1fr 46px 30px; gap:8px; align-items:center;
background:var(--surface-1); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:9px; padding:8px;
}
.item.eu{grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1.4fr 46px 30px}
@media(max-width:780px){ .item, .item.eu{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } }
.item .sc{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:700; text-align:center; font-size:13px; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 0}
.del{background:none; border:0; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; font-size:15px; padding:2px}
.del:hover{color:var(--critical)}
/* sub-score readout */
.sub{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:2px}
.pill{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; font-size:12px}
.p5{background:rgba(12,163,12,.14); color:var(--good)}
.p4{background:rgba(12,163,12,.10); color:var(--good)}
.p3{background:rgba(250,178,25,.18); color:#8a6100}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .p3{color:var(--warning)}
.p2{background:rgba(236,131,90,.18); color:#a8482a}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .p2{color:var(--serious)}
.p1{background:rgba(208,59,59,.15); color:var(--critical)}
.p0{background:var(--plane); color:var(--muted)}
/* ---- results ---- */
.results{position:sticky; top:82px}
.verdict{
border-radius:12px; padding:16px 18px; color:#fff; margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.verdict .vlabel{font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.09em; opacity:.9}
.verdict .vmain{font-size:20px; font-weight:700; margin:4px 0 2px; letter-spacing:-.01em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px}
.verdict .vsub{font-size:13px; opacity:.95}
.verdict.v-excellent{background:#0ca30c}
.verdict.v-good{background:#178a4c}
.verdict.v-fair{background:#b07800}
.verdict.v-marginal{background:#c2622f}
.verdict.v-poor{background:#c03535}
.verdict.v-gate{background:#a02b2b}
.verdict.v-idle{background:#6b6a66}
.scorebox{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px; margin-bottom:14px}
.stat{background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:11px; padding:12px 14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.stat .k{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em}
.stat .v{font-size:26px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.02em; margin-top:2px; line-height:1.15}
.stat .v small{font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted)}
.stat .d{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:2px}
table.bd{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px}
table.bd th{
text-align:left; font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em;
color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; padding:0 6px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid);
}
table.bd th.n, table.bd td.n{text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
table.bd td{padding:7px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid); vertical-align:middle}
table.bd tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.meter{height:7px; background:var(--plane); border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; min-width:60px; border:1px solid var(--border)}
.meter i{display:block; height:100%; border-radius:4px}
.gatebad{color:var(--critical); font-weight:700}
.gateok{color:var(--good); font-weight:700}
.flaglist{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font-size:12.5px}
.flaglist li{display:flex; gap:8px; padding:7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid); align-items:flex-start}
.flaglist li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.flaglist .ic{flex:none; font-weight:700; width:14px; text-align:center}
.ic.bad{color:var(--critical)} .ic.warn{color:#8a6100} .ic.ok{color:var(--good)}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .ic.warn{color:var(--warning)}
.panel{background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.panel h3{font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 10px; font-weight:640}
details.ref{background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
details.ref > summary{padding:12px 16px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:620; font-size:13.5px; list-style:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
details.ref > summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
details.ref > summary::before{content:"▸"; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px}
details.ref[open] > summary::before{content:"▾"}
details.ref .rbody{padding:0 16px 16px; font-size:12.5px}
table.ref{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12px; margin:6px 0 14px}
table.ref th{background:var(--plane); text-align:left; padding:6px 8px; font-weight:620; border:1px solid var(--border)}
table.ref td{padding:5px 8px; border:1px solid var(--border)}
table.ref td.n{text-align:center; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:650}
h4.rt{font-size:12.5px; margin:12px 0 4px; font-weight:650}
code{background:var(--plane); padding:1px 5px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11.5px}
.foot{padding:6px 22px 30px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); max-width:1560px; margin:0 auto}
.legend{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:8px}
.legend span{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px}
.sw{width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:3px; display:inline-block}
@media print{
header.top, .seg, .del, .btn, .card .head .chev, details.ref{display:none !important}
body{background:#fff}
.wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr; padding:0}
.card .body{display:block !important}
.results{position:static}
.card, .panel, .stat{box-shadow:none; break-inside:avoid}
.verdict{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="top">
<div>
<h1>Hydrogen Blending Pipeline Screening Tool</h1>
<div class="sub">PNGRB Roadmap for Hydrogen Transportation through Pipelines &amp; Blending with Natural Gas (Sept 2025) — Module B.1, 9-Parameter Screening Methodology</div>
</div>
<div class="spacer"></div>

<button class="btn sm" onclick="resetAll()">Reset</button>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="saveJSON()">Save inputs</button>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="document.getElementById('fileIn').click()">Load inputs</button>
<input type="file" id="fileIn" accept=".json" style="display:none" onchange="loadJSON(event)">
<button class="btn sm" onclick="exportCSV()">Export CSV</button>
<button class="btn sm primary" onclick="window.print()">Print report</button>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="toggleTheme()" id="themeBtn">Dark</button>
</header>
<div class="wrap">
<!-- ============ LEFT: INPUTS ============ -->
<div class="inputs">
<div class="card open">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">ID</div><h2>Segment identification</h2><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<div class="row c3">
<div class="field"><label>Operator / entity</label><input type="text" id="op" placeholder="e.g. GAIL / GSPC"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Pipeline / network name</label><input type="text" id="plname" placeholder="e.g. Dahej–Vijaipur"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Section ID</label><input type="text" id="secid" placeholder="e.g. SEC-014"></div>
</div>
<div class="row c4">
<div class="field"><label>Chainage from (km)</label><input type="number" id="chFrom" step="0.01" placeholder="0.00"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Chainage to (km)</label><input type="number" id="chTo" step="0.01" placeholder="5.00"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Nominal size (inch)</label><input type="number" id="dia" step="0.5" placeholder="12"></div>
<div class="field"><label>System type</label>
<select id="systype"><option value="NGPL">NGPL — Transmission [T]</option><option value="CGD">CGD — Distribution</option></select>
</div>
</div>
<p class="note">B.1 scores segments divided into <strong>1–5 km sections</strong>. Assess one section at a time; use Export CSV to build the registry.</p>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 1 MATERIAL -->
<div class="card open" id="c-mat">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">1</div><h2>Material Compatibility</h2><span class="wt">14%</span><span class="mini" id="m-mat">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Resistance to hydrogen embrittlement / permeation. Lower-grade carbon steels (X42–X52) and PE100 score best. <em>Tables 4 &amp; 5.</em></p>
<div class="seg" id="seg-mat">
<button data-v="steel" class="on" onclick="segSet('mat',this)">Steel only</button>
<button data-v="pe" onclick="segSet('mat',this)">PE only</button>
<button data-v="both" onclick="segSet('mat',this)">Steel + PE (min)</button>
</div>
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field" id="f-steel"><label>Steel grade (API 5L)</label>
<select id="steelGrade" onchange="calc()">
<option value="">— select —</option>
<option value="GRB">API 5L Gr. B</option>
<option value="X42">API 5L X42–X52 (below X52)</option>
<option value="X52">API 5L X52–X60</option>
<option value="X60">API 5L X60–X70</option>
<option value="X70">API 5L X70–X80</option>
<option value="X80">API 5L X80 and higher</option>
</select>
<div class="hint" id="steelHint"></div>
</div>
<div class="field" id="f-pe" style="display:none"><label>PE grade</label>
<select id="peGrade" onchange="calc()">
<option value="">— select —</option>
<option value="PE100">PE100</option>
<option value="PE80">PE80</option>
<option value="PE63">PE63</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 2 WELD -->
<div class="card open" id="c-weld">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">2</div><h2>Weld Integrity</h2><span class="wt">14%</span><span class="mini" id="m-weld">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Girth welds are the critical locus for hydrogen-induced cracking. Primary route uses Vickers hardness (HV) + PAUT flaw density. <em>Tables 6 &amp; 7; alternate route per Matrices A &amp; B.</em></p>
<div class="seg" id="seg-weld">
<button data-v="primary" class="on" onclick="segSet('weld',this)">Primary (HV + PAUT)</button>
<button data-v="alt" onclick="segSet('weld',this)">Alternate (no weld traceability)</button>
</div>
<div id="weld-primary">
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field"><label>Max weld hardness (HV)</label><input type="number" id="hv" step="1" placeholder="e.g. 215" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-hv"></div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Weld flaw density (%)</label><input type="number" id="flaw" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 1.5" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-flaw"></div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="weld-alt" style="display:none">
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field"><label>Acceptance code compliance</label>
<select id="accCode" onchange="calc()">
<option value="">— select —</option>
<option value="5">Fully compliant with ASME/API standards</option>
<option value="4">Minor deviations, documented repairs</option>
<option value="3">Compliant with legacy codes, no recent validation</option>
<option value="2">Partial compliance, limited documentation</option>
<option value="1">Non-compliant or undocumented</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="field"><label>Defect rate in sampled welds (%)</label><input type="number" id="ndt" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 1.8" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-ndt"></div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 3 COMPONENT -->
<div class="card open" id="c-comp">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">3</div><h2>Component Readiness</h2><span class="wt">12%</span><span class="mini" id="m-comp">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Score is the <strong>minimum</strong> of all individual valve and compressor scores — the least compatible element limits overall readiness. <em>Tables 8–11.</em></p>
<h4 class="rt">Valves</h4>
<div class="itemlist" id="valveList"></div>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="addValve()">+ Add valve</button>
<h4 class="rt" style="margin-top:16px">Compressors / stations</h4>
<div class="itemlist" id="compList"></div>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="addComp()">+ Add compressor</button>
<div class="hint" style="margin-top:8px">Compressor blend rating must be the <strong>OEM-approved</strong> H₂ blend limit. Leave the compressor list empty for CGD zones with no compression on the segment.</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 4 END USE -->
<div class="card open" id="c-eu">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">4</div><h2>End-Use Compatibility</h2><span class="wt">12%</span><span class="mini" id="m-eu">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Score is the <strong>minimum</strong> across all downstream equipment — the least tolerant device sets the system limit. <em>Table 12.</em></p>
<div class="itemlist" id="euList"></div>
<button class="btn sm" onclick="addEU()">+ Add end user / equipment</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 5 AGE -->
<div class="card open" id="c-age">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">5</div><h2>Age of Pipeline</h2><span class="wt">12%</span><span class="mini" id="m-age">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Proxy for fatigue, corrosion and outdated specification. <em>Table 13.</em></p>
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field"><label>Age in service (years)</label><input type="number" id="age" step="0.5" placeholder="e.g. 8" oninput="calc()"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Commissioning year (optional)</label><input type="number" id="commYr" step="1" placeholder="e.g. 2016" oninput="fromYear()"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 6 GAS LOSS -->
<div class="card open" id="c-loss">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">6</div><h2>Gas Losses</h2><span class="wt">10%</span><span class="mini" id="m-loss">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Hydrogen's small molecular size and high diffusivity amplify existing leakage paths. <em>Table 14.</em></p>
<div class="field" style="max-width:280px"><label>Unaccounted for gas / gas loss (%)</label><input type="number" id="loss" step="0.01" placeholder="e.g. 0.35" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-loss"></div></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 7 CLASS LOCATION -->
<div class="card open" id="c-loc">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">7</div><h2>Class of Location</h2><span class="wt">10%</span><span class="mini" id="m-loc">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Length-weighted average across the section: <code>(L1×5 + L2×3 + L3×2 + L4×1) ÷ ΣL</code>. <em>Table 15.</em></p>
<div class="row c4">
<div class="field"><label>Class 1 length (km)</label><input type="number" id="L1" step="0.01" placeholder="0" oninput="calc()"><div class="hint">Rural, very low density — score 5</div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Class 2 length (km)</label><input type="number" id="L2" step="0.01" placeholder="0" oninput="calc()"><div class="hint">Suburban — score 3</div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Class 3 length (km)</label><input type="number" id="L3" step="0.01" placeholder="0" oninput="calc()"><div class="hint">Urban, high density — score 2</div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Class 4 length (km)</label><input type="number" id="L4" step="0.01" placeholder="0" oninput="calc()"><div class="hint">HCA / critical infra — score 1</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sub" id="s-loc"></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 8 CORROSION -->
<div class="card open" id="c-corr">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">8</div><h2>Corrosion</h2><span class="wt">8%</span><span class="mini" id="m-corr">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Two equally weighted sub-parameters: corrosion rate and residual thickness ratio (from ILI / DCVG / UT data). <em>Tables 16 &amp; 17.</em></p>
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field"><label>Corrosion rate (mm/year)</label><input type="number" id="corrRate" step="0.01" placeholder="e.g. 0.15" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-cr"></div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Residual thickness ratio (t<sub>remaining</sub> / t<sub>nominal</sub>)</label><input type="number" id="rtr" step="0.01" placeholder="e.g. 0.96" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-rtr"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="hint">Scoring assumes uniform (general) wall loss. Assess pitting and crack-like features separately where ILI data supports it.</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 9 CAPACITY -->
<div class="card open" id="c-cap">
<div class="head" onclick="tog(this)"><div class="num">9</div><h2>Capacity Utilisation &amp; MAOP</h2><span class="wt">8%</span><span class="mini" id="m-cap">—</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
<div class="body">
<p class="note">Two equally weighted sub-parameters: reserve throughput capacity and pressure buffer below MAOP. <em>Table 18.</em></p>
<div class="row c2">
<div class="field"><label>Capacity utilisation (%)</label><input type="number" id="cap" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 88" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-cap"></div></div>
<div class="field"><label>Operating pressure as % of MAOP</label><input type="number" id="opm" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 62" oninput="calc()"><div class="sub" id="s-opm"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="row c3" style="margin-top:2px">
<div class="field"><label>MAOP (bar) — optional</label><input type="number" id="maop" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 92" oninput="fromPressure()"></div>
<div class="field"><label>Operating pressure (bar) — optional</label><input type="number" id="oppr" step="0.1" placeholder="e.g. 57" oninput="fromPressure()"></div>
<div class="field"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<details class="ref">
<summary>Reference scoring tables (as per PNGRB B.1)</summary>
<div class="rbody" id="refTables"></div>
</details>
<details class="ref">
<summary>Engineering interpretations applied in this tool</summary>
<div class="rbody">
<p>The report leaves five points to engineering judgement. This tool resolves them as follows — change them in the source if your assessment basis differs.</p>
<ol style="padding-left:18px; margin:8px 0">
<li><strong>Weld integrity, primary route.</strong> The report gives an explicit combination formula only for the alternate route (0.5/0.5). The primary route (hardness + flaw density) is combined here with the same equal weighting: <code>0.5 × hardness score + 0.5 × flaw density score</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Per-component score.</strong> A valve is scored <code>min(body material, age)</code> and a compressor <code>min(OEM blend limit, age)</code>, before the overall minimum is taken across all items — consistent with the module's stated principle that the least compatible element limits overall readiness. (An averaging basis would raise scores; it is the less conservative reading.)</li>
<li><strong>Corrosion rate units.</strong> Table 16 prints its bands with a "%" symbol while the parameter description defines corrosion in mm/year. The bands are applied here as <strong>mm/year</strong>, per the description.</li>
<li><strong>Open-ended bands.</strong> Corrosion rate below 0.1 mm/yr and capacity utilisation below 87% fall outside the tabulated ranges; both are treated as the best band (score 5).</li>
<li><strong>Band endpoints.</strong> Several tables share an endpoint between adjacent bands (e.g. Table 13 lists both "&lt;10" and "10–20"; Table 18 lists both "87–90" and "90–93"). At a shared endpoint the tool assigns the <strong>lower, more conservative</strong> score — so 10 years scores 4, not 5, and 90% utilisation scores 4, not 5. Tables with explicitly disjoint bands (6, 7, 10, 12) are applied exactly as printed.</li>
<li><strong>API 5L Gr. B.</strong> Not listed in Table 4. On the toughness/yield-strength logic of that table it scores 5, and it is scored 5 here — but flagged, because the preliminary screening in Table 22 marks Gr. B as not compatible, most likely on vintage and documentation grounds rather than strength. Confirm against the actual mill certificates before relying on it.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
</div>
<!-- ============ RIGHT: RESULTS ============ -->
<div class="results">
<div class="verdict v-idle" id="verdict">
<div class="vlabel">Screening verdict</div>
<div class="vmain" id="vMain">Awaiting input</div>
<div class="vsub" id="vSub">Complete all nine parameters to produce a verdict.</div>
</div>
<div class="scorebox">
<div class="stat">
<div class="k">Total pipeline score</div>
<div class="v" id="totalScore">—<small> / 5.00</small></div>
<div class="d" id="ratingTxt">weighted, 9 parameters</div>
</div>
<div class="stat">
<div class="k">Minimum-score gate</div>
<div class="v" id="gateVal">—</div>
<div class="d" id="gateTxt">every parameter must be ≥ 4.00</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h3>Parameter breakdown</h3>
<table class="bd">
<thead><tr><th>Parameter</th><th class="n">Score</th><th style="width:70px">Level</th><th class="n">Wt</th><th class="n">Contrib.</th><th class="n">Gate</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="bdBody"></tbody>
<tfoot><tr><td colspan="4" style="padding-top:8px; font-weight:650">Total</td><td class="n" id="bdTotal" style="padding-top:8px; font-weight:700">—</td><td></td></tr></tfoot>
</table>
<div class="legend">
<span><i class="sw" style="background:#0ca30c"></i>5.0–4.5</span>
<span><i class="sw" style="background:#178a4c"></i>4.5–4.0</span>
<span><i class="sw" style="background:#fab219"></i>4.0–3.0</span>
<span><i class="sw" style="background:#ec835a"></i>3.0–2.0</span>
<span><i class="sw" style="background:#d03b3b"></i>&lt; 2.0</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h3>Findings — why this outcome</h3>
<ul class="flaglist" id="reasons"><li><span class="ic">·</span><span>Enter segment data to generate findings.</span></li></ul>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h3>Red flags (B.1 snapshot check)</h3>
<ul class="flaglist" id="redflags"></ul>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h3>Governing blend limit &amp; required actions</h3>
<div id="actions" style="font-size:12.5px"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="foot">
Implements the 9-parameter screening methodology of Module B.1 (Pipeline Identification), <em>Roadmap for Hydrogen Transportation through Pipelines and Blending with Natural Gas</em>, PNGRB / ICF Consulting India, September 2025 — Tables 4–20, pp. 22–32.
Screening output only: it prioritises candidates for pilot consideration and does not replace a fitness-for-service assessment, a hydrogen-specific fracture-control plan, or the acceptance requirements of Module B.2.
</div>
<script>
"use strict";
/* ============================================================
SCORING ENGINE — PNGRB Module B.1
============================================================ */
const WEIGHTS = {
mat:0.14, weld:0.14, comp:0.12, eu:0.12, age:0.12,
loss:0.10, loc:0.10, corr:0.08, cap:0.08
};
const PNAMES = {
mat:"Material Compatibility", weld:"Weld Integrity", comp:"Component Readiness",
eu:"End-Use Compatibility", age:"Age of Pipeline", loss:"Gas Losses",
loc:"Class of Location", corr:"Corrosion", cap:"Capacity Utilisation & MAOP"
};
const GATE = 4.0;
// Table 4 — steel grade
const STEEL = {GRB:5, X42:5, X52:4, X60:3, X70:2, X80:1};
const STEEL_LBL = {GRB:"API 5L Gr. B", X42:"API 5L X42–X52", X52:"API 5L X52–X60",
X60:"API 5L X60–X70", X70:"API 5L X70–X80", X80:"API 5L X80+"};
// Table 5 — PE grade
const PE = {PE100:5, PE80:4, PE63:2};
/* Banded lookup.
Each entry is [limit, score, strict]: strict=true → matches when v < limit
strict=false→ matches when v <= limit
Where the source tables share an endpoint between two bands (e.g. "<10" and
"10–20"), the boundary value is assigned the LOWER, more conservative score. */
function band(v, bands){
if(v===null||v===undefined||isNaN(v)) return null;
for(const [lim,sc,strict] of bands){ if(strict ? v<lim : v<=lim) return sc; }
return bands[bands.length-1][1];
}
const T=true, F=false;
const HV_B = [[200,5,F],[230,4,F],[250,3,F],[280,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 6 (explicit integer bands)
const FLAW_B = [[1,5,F],[2,4,F],[3,3,F],[5,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 7 (≤1, >1–2, …)
const NDT_B = [[1,5,F],[2,4,F],[3,3,F],[5,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Matrix B
const VAGE_B = [[5,5,T],[10,4,T],[15,3,T],[20,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Tables 9 / 11
const BLEND_B = [[2,1,F],[5,2,F],[10,3,F],[15,4,F],[Infinity,5,F]]; // Table 10 (compressor OEM limit)
const EU_B = [[1,1,F],[3,2,F],[5,3,F],[10,4,F],[Infinity,5,F]]; // Table 12 ("up to" = inclusive)
const AGE_B = [[10,5,T],[20,4,T],[30,3,T],[40,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 13
const LOSS_B = [[0.1,5,T],[0.4,4,T],[0.6,3,T],[1,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 14
const CORR_B = [[0.2,5,T],[0.4,4,T],[0.6,3,T],[1,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 16 (mm/yr)
const CAP_B = [[90,5,T],[93,4,T],[96.5,3,T],[98.5,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 18a
const OPM_B = [[30,5,T],[50,4,T],[70,3,T],[90,2,F],[Infinity,1,F]]; // Table 18b
const VBODY = {ss316:5, duplex:3, carbon:1}; // Table 8
const VBODY_LBL= {ss316:"Austenitic SS (316L)", duplex:"Duplex SS", carbon:"Carbon steel / Al alloy"};
// Table 17 — residual thickness ratio (descending bands, conservative at endpoints)
function rtrScore(v){
if(v===null||v===undefined||isNaN(v)) return null;
if(v>0.95) return 5;
if(v>0.90) return 4;
if(v>0.80) return 3;
if(v>=0.70) return 2;
return 1;
}
// Table 20 — evaluation
function rating(total){
if(total>=4.50) return {key:"excellent", label:"Excellent", action:"Blending without retro-fitment may be possible."};
if(total>=4.40) return {key:"good", label:"Good", action:"Blending possible with minor retro-fitment."};
if(total>=4.20) return {key:"fair", label:"Fair", action:"Moderate retro-fitment required before blending."};
if(total>=4.00) return {key:"marginal", label:"Marginal", action:"Extensive mitigation required before blending."};
return {key:"poor", label:"Poor", action:"Rejection for blending."};
}
/* ---------- input helpers ---------- */
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const num = id => { const v = $(id).value.trim(); return v==="" ? null : parseFloat(v); };
const modes = {mat:"steel", weld:"primary"};
function segSet(group, btn){
modes[group] = btn.dataset.v;
btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on", b===btn));
if(group==="mat"){
$("f-steel").style.display = (modes.mat==="pe") ? "none" : "";
$("f-pe").style.display = (modes.mat==="steel") ? "none" : "";
}
if(group==="weld"){
$("weld-primary").style.display = modes.weld==="primary" ? "" : "none";
$("weld-alt").style.display = modes.weld==="alt" ? "" : "none";
}
calc();
}
function tog(h){ h.parentElement.classList.toggle("open"); }
function fromYear(){
const y = num("commYr");
if(y && y>1900 && y<2200){ $("age").value = (new Date().getFullYear() - y); }
calc();
}
function fromPressure(){
const m = num("maop"), o = num("oppr");
if(m && o && m>0){ $("opm").value = (100*o/m).toFixed(1); }
calc();
}
/* ---------- dynamic item lists ---------- */
let vSeq=0, cSeq=0, eSeq=0;
function addValve(d){
d = d||{};
const id = "v"+(vSeq++);
const el = document.createElement("div");
el.className="item"; el.id=id;
el.innerHTML = `
<input type="text" placeholder="Valve tag" value="${d.tag||""}" data-f="tag">
<select data-f="body" onchange="calc()">
<option value="">— body material —</option>
<option value="ss316" ${d.body==="ss316"?"selected":""}>Austenitic SS (316L)</option>
<option value="duplex" ${d.body==="duplex"?"selected":""}>Duplex SS</option>
<option value="carbon" ${d.body==="carbon"?"selected":""}>Carbon steel / Al alloy</option>
</select>
<input type="number" placeholder="Age (yr)" value="${d.age??""}" data-f="age" oninput="calc()">
<div class="sc p0" data-f="score">—</div>
<button class="del" onclick="this.parentElement.remove();calc()" title="Remove">×</button>`;
$("valveList").appendChild(el); calc();
}
function addComp(d){
d = d||{};
const el = document.createElement("div");
el.className="item";
el.innerHTML = `
<input type="text" placeholder="Compressor tag" value="${d.tag||""}" data-f="tag">
<input type="number" placeholder="OEM blend limit (%)" value="${d.blend??""}" data-f="blend" oninput="calc()">
<input type="number" placeholder="Age (yr)" value="${d.age??""}" data-f="age" oninput="calc()">
<div class="sc p0" data-f="score">—</div>
<button class="del" onclick="this.parentElement.remove();calc()" title="Remove">×</button>`;
$("compList").appendChild(el); calc();
}
function addEU(d){
d = d||{};
const el = document.createElement("div");
el.className="item eu";
el.innerHTML = `
<input type="text" placeholder="End user / equipment" value="${d.name||""}" data-f="name">
<input type="number" placeholder="Tolerated blend limit (%)" value="${d.limit??""}" data-f="limit" oninput="calc()">
<div class="sc p0" data-f="score">—</div>
<button class="del" onclick="this.parentElement.remove();calc()" title="Remove">×</button>`;
$("euList").appendChild(el); calc();
}
function readItems(listId){
return [...$(listId).children].map(el=>{
const o={el};
el.querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(f=>{
if(f.dataset.f==="score") return;
o[f.dataset.f] = (f.value==="" ? null : (f.type==="number" ? parseFloat(f.value) : f.value));
});
return o;
});
}
function pcls(s){ return s===null?"p0":"p"+Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Math.round(s))); }
function setSc(item, s){
const d = item.el.querySelector('[data-f="score"]');
d.textContent = s===null ? "—" : s.toFixed(1);
d.className = "sc " + pcls(s);
}
/* ============================================================
MAIN CALCULATION
============================================================ */
let LAST = null;
function calc(){
const S = {}; // parameter scores
const D = {}; // detail / reason strings
const missing = [];
/* --- 1 Material --- */
{
const g = $("steelGrade").value, p = $("peGrade").value;
const sSteel = g ? STEEL[g] : null, sPE = p ? PE[p] : null;
let s=null, txt="";
if(modes.mat==="steel"){ s=sSteel; txt = g ? STEEL_LBL[g] : ""; }
else if(modes.mat==="pe"){ s=sPE; txt = p||""; }
else if(sSteel!==null && sPE!==null){ s=Math.min(sSteel,sPE); txt = STEEL_LBL[g]+" + "+p+" (governing: "+(sSteel<=sPE?STEEL_LBL[g]:p)+")"; }
S.mat = s;
D.mat = s===null ? "Material grade not entered." :
txt + " → " + s.toFixed(1) + (s>=4 ? " — low susceptibility to hydrogen embrittlement / permeation."
: s===3 ? " — moderate resistance; monitoring required above ~50 bar H₂ partial pressure."
: " — high-strength / high-permeability material, susceptible to hydrogen damage.");
$("steelHint").textContent = g==="GRB" ? "Gr. B is not tabulated in Table 4; scored 5 on toughness logic but flagged — Table 22 preliminary screening marks Gr. B as not compatible." : "";
}
/* --- 2 Weld --- */
{
let s=null, txt="";
if(modes.weld==="primary"){
const h = band(num("hv"), HV_B), f = band(num("flaw"), FLAW_B);
pill("s-hv", h, num("hv")===null?"":"hardness score");
pill("s-flaw", f, num("flaw")===null?"":"flaw density score");
if(h!==null && f!==null){ s = 0.5*h + 0.5*f; txt = `HV ${num("hv")} → ${h}; flaw density ${num("flaw")}% → ${f}; equal weighting → ${s.toFixed(2)}`; }
} else {
const a = $("accCode").value ? parseFloat($("accCode").value) : null;
const n = band(num("ndt"), NDT_B);
pill("s-ndt", n, num("ndt")===null?"":"NDT sampling score");
if(a!==null && n!==null){ s = 0.5*a + 0.5*n; txt = `Acceptance code ${a}; sampled defect rate ${num("ndt")}% → ${n}; (0.5/0.5) → ${s.toFixed(2)}`; }
}
S.weld = s;
D.weld = s===null ? "Weld data not entered." :
txt + (s>=4 ? " — girth welds within hydrogen-tolerant hardness/flaw envelope."
: " — weld condition is a limiting factor for hydrogen-induced cracking resistance.");
}
/* --- 3 Component readiness --- */
{
const valves = readItems("valveList"), comps = readItems("compList");
let scores=[], worst=null, worstName="", oemLimits=[];
valves.forEach(v=>{
const b = v.body?VBODY[v.body]:null, a = band(v.age, VAGE_B);
const sc = (b===null||a===null) ? null : Math.min(b,a);
setSc(v, sc);
if(sc!==null){ scores.push(sc); if(worst===null||sc<worst){worst=sc; worstName=(v.tag||"valve")+" ("+(b<=a?VBODY_LBL[v.body]:v.age+" yr")+")";} }
});
comps.forEach(c=>{
const b = band(c.blend, BLEND_B), a = band(c.age, VAGE_B);
const sc = (b===null||a===null) ? null : Math.min(b,a);
setSc(c, sc);
if(c.blend!==null) oemLimits.push({name:c.tag||"compressor", lim:c.blend});
if(sc!==null){ scores.push(sc); if(worst===null||sc<worst){worst=sc; worstName=(c.tag||"compressor")+" ("+(b<=a?c.blend+"% OEM limit":c.age+" yr")+")";} }
});
S.comp = scores.length ? Math.min(...scores) : null;
D.comp = S.comp===null ? "No valve or compressor data entered."
: `Governed by ${worstName} → ${S.comp.toFixed(1)} (minimum of ${scores.length} component${scores.length>1?"s":""}).`
+ (S.comp>=4 ? " Components are admissible for blend service subject to OEM confirmation." : " This component must be upgraded, replaced or OEM-requalified.");
D._oem = oemLimits;
}
/* --- 4 End use --- */
{
const eus = readItems("euList");
let scores=[], worst=null, worstName="", limits=[];
eus.forEach(e=>{
const sc = band(e.limit, EU_B);
setSc(e, sc);
if(e.limit!==null) limits.push({name:e.name||"end user", lim:e.limit});
if(sc!==null){ scores.push(sc); if(worst===null||sc<worst){worst=sc; worstName=(e.name||"end user")+" @ "+e.limit+"%";} }
});
S.eu = scores.length ? Math.min(...scores) : null;
D.eu = S.eu===null ? "No downstream equipment entered."
: `Least tolerant load: ${worstName} → ${S.eu.toFixed(1)}.`
+ (S.eu>=4 ? " Downstream fleet accepts blends above 5%." : " Downstream tolerance caps the achievable blend well below pilot targets.");
D._eu = limits;
}
/* --- 5 Age --- */
{
const a = num("age");
S.age = band(a, AGE_B);
D.age = S.age===null ? "Pipeline age not entered."
: `${a} years in service → ${S.age.toFixed(1)}.` + (S.age>=4 ? " Within the ≤20-year vintage band favoured for blending candidates." : " Vintage asset — accumulated degradation raises hydrogen risk.");
}
/* --- 6 Gas loss --- */
{
const l = num("loss");
S.loss = band(l, LOSS_B);
pill("s-loss", S.loss, l===null?"":"gas loss score");
D.loss = S.loss===null ? "Gas loss not entered."
: `${l}% loss → ${S.loss.toFixed(1)}.` + (S.loss>=4 ? " Tight system; hydrogen's higher diffusivity is manageable." : " Existing leakage will be amplified by hydrogen — leak survey and repair needed first.");
}
/* --- 7 Class location --- */
{
const L = [num("L1")||0, num("L2")||0, num("L3")||0, num("L4")||0];
const tot = L.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
S.loc = tot>0 ? (L[0]*5 + L[1]*3 + L[2]*2 + L[3]*1)/tot : null;
D._hca = (L[2]+L[3])>0;
D._hcaKm = L[2]+L[3];
D._locLen = tot;
$("s-loc").innerHTML = tot>0
? `<span class="pill ${pcls(S.loc)}">${S.loc.toFixed(2)}</span><span>length-weighted over ${tot.toFixed(2)} km — Class 3+4 exposure ${(L[2]+L[3]).toFixed(2)} km (${(100*(L[2]+L[3])/tot).toFixed(0)}%)</span>`
: "";
D.loc = S.loc===null ? "Class location lengths not entered."
: `Length-weighted ${S.loc.toFixed(2)} over ${tot.toFixed(2)} km.` + (S.loc>=4 ? " Predominantly Class 1 routing — low consequence exposure." : ` ${(L[2]+L[3]).toFixed(2)} km in Class 3/4 raises consequence severity above the screening threshold.`);
}
/* --- 8 Corrosion --- */
{
const r = num("corrRate"), t = num("rtr");
const sr = band(r, CORR_B), st = rtrScore(t);
pill("s-cr", sr, r===null?"":"corrosion rate score");
pill("s-rtr", st, t===null?"":"residual thickness score");
S.corr = (sr===null||st===null) ? null : 0.5*sr + 0.5*st;
D._rtr = t;
D.corr = S.corr===null ? "Corrosion data not entered."
: `Rate ${r} mm/yr → ${sr}; RTR ${t} → ${st}; equal weighting → ${S.corr.toFixed(2)}.`
+ (S.corr>=4 ? " Wall condition and corrosion control are adequate for blend service." : " Wall loss / active corrosion must be remediated before hydrogen introduction.");
}
/* --- 9 Capacity & MAOP --- */
{
const c = num("cap"), o = num("opm");
const sc = band(c, CAP_B), so = band(o, OPM_B);
pill("s-cap", sc, c===null?"":"capacity score");
pill("s-opm", so, o===null?"":"pressure buffer score");
S.cap = (sc===null||so===null) ? null : 0.5*sc + 0.5*so;
D.cap = S.cap===null ? "Capacity / MAOP data not entered."
: `Utilisation ${c}% → ${sc}; operating at ${o}% of MAOP → ${so}; equal weighting → ${S.cap.toFixed(2)}.`
+ (S.cap>=4 ? " Adequate throughput headroom and pressure margin to absorb a blend." : " Little headroom — blending would erode the flow and pressure margin.");
}
/* --- aggregate --- */
let total=0, complete=true;
for(const k in WEIGHTS){
if(S[k]===null){ complete=false; missing.push(PNAMES[k]); }
else total += S[k]*WEIGHTS[k];
}
const failed = Object.keys(WEIGHTS).filter(k=>S[k]!==null && S[k] < GATE);
LAST = {S, D, total, complete, failed, missing};
render(S, D, total, complete, failed, missing);
}
function pill(id, s, label){
const el = $(id);
if(!el) return;
el.innerHTML = (s===null) ? "" : `<span class="pill ${pcls(s)}">${s.toFixed(1)}</span><span>${label}</span>`;
}
/* ============================================================
RENDER
============================================================ */
function render(S, D, total, complete, failed, missing){
// mini scores in headers
const map={mat:"m-mat",weld:"m-weld",comp:"m-comp",eu:"m-eu",age:"m-age",loss:"m-loss",loc:"m-loc",corr:"m-corr",cap:"m-cap"};
for(const k in map){
const el=$(map[k]);
el.textContent = S[k]===null ? "—" : S[k].toFixed(2);
el.style.color = S[k]===null ? "var(--muted)" : (S[k]>=4 ? "var(--good)" : S[k]>=3 ? "#8a6100" : "var(--critical)");
}
// breakdown table
const rows = Object.keys(WEIGHTS).map(k=>{
const s=S[k], w=WEIGHTS[k];
const col = s===null?"var(--axis)": s>=4.5?"#0ca30c": s>=4?"#178a4c": s>=3?"#fab219": s>=2?"#ec835a":"#d03b3b";
return `<tr>
<td>${PNAMES[k]}</td>
<td class="n" style="font-weight:650">${s===null?"—":s.toFixed(2)}</td>
<td><div class="meter"><i style="width:${s===null?0:(s/5*100)}%;background:${col}"></i></div></td>
<td class="n">${(w*100).toFixed(0)}%</td>
<td class="n">${s===null?"—":(s*w).toFixed(3)}</td>
<td class="n">${s===null?'<span style="color:var(--muted)">—</span>': (s>=GATE?'<span class="gateok">✓</span>':'<span class="gatebad">✕</span>')}</td>
</tr>`;
}).join("");
$("bdBody").innerHTML = rows;
$("bdTotal").textContent = complete ? total.toFixed(3) : total.toFixed(3)+" *";
// headline stats
$("totalScore").innerHTML = (complete? total.toFixed(2) : "—") + "<small> / 5.00</small>";
const r = rating(total);
$("ratingTxt").textContent = complete ? r.label + " band (Table 20)" : "incomplete — " + missing.length + " parameter(s) missing";
$("gateVal").innerHTML = complete
? (failed.length===0 ? '<span style="color:var(--good)">PASS</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--critical)">FAIL</span>')
: "—";
$("gateTxt").textContent = complete
? (failed.length===0 ? "all nine parameters ≥ 4.00" : failed.length + " parameter(s) below 4.00")
: "every parameter must be ≥ 4.00";
// verdict
const v=$("verdict");
v.className = "verdict";
if(!complete){
v.classList.add("v-idle");
$("vMain").textContent = "Incomplete";
$("vSub").textContent = "Missing: " + missing.join(", ") + ".";
} else if(failed.length){
v.classList.add("v-gate");
$("vMain").innerHTML = "✕ Not suitable as-is";
$("vSub").textContent = "Fails the B.1 minimum-score gate on " + failed.map(k=>PNAMES[k]).join(", ")
+ ". A minimum of 4 must be met individually for each parameter, not merely as an overall average.";
} else {
v.classList.add("v-"+r.key);
$("vMain").innerHTML = (r.key==="excellent"||r.key==="good" ? "✓ " : "◐ ") + "Suitable — " + r.label;
$("vSub").textContent = r.action;
}
// reasons
const order = ["mat","weld","comp","eu","age","loss","loc","corr","cap"];
$("reasons").innerHTML = order.map(k=>{
const s=S[k];
const ic = s===null ? '<span class="ic">·</span>' : (s>=GATE ? '<span class="ic ok">✓</span>' : '<span class="ic bad">✕</span>');
return `<li>${ic}<span><strong>${PNAMES[k]}</strong> — ${D[k]}</span></li>`;
}).join("");
// red flags — B.1 "Module at a glance" snapshot
const flags=[];
const g=$("steelGrade").value;
if(g==="X70"||g==="X80") flags.push(["bad","High-strength steel (X70+) — the module lists this as a red flag; hydrogen embrittlement mitigation or retro-fitment is required."]);
if(g==="GRB") flags.push(["warn","API 5L Gr. B is not tabulated in Table 4 and is marked not compatible in the Table 22 preliminary screening. Verify mill certificates and vintage before accepting a score of 5."]);
if(S.weld!==null && S.weld<4) flags.push(["bad","Poor weld data / weld condition — listed red flag."]);
if(modes.weld==="alt") flags.push(["warn","Alternate weld route in use: individual weld traceability is unavailable, so the weld score rests on code compliance and sampling rather than measured girth-weld condition."]);
if(S.loss!==null && S.loss<4) flags.push(["bad","High gas loss — listed red flag; hydrogen will amplify existing leakage."]);
if(D._hca) flags.push([S.loc!==null&&S.loc<4?"bad":"warn", `HCA exposure — ${D._hcaKm.toFixed(2)} km of the section is Class 3/4. Field validation of location class is required before pilot approval.`]);
if(D._rtr!==null && D._rtr!==undefined && !isNaN(D._rtr) && D._rtr<0.9) flags.push(["bad","Residual thickness ratio below 0.90 — listed red flag (corrosion RPR < 0.9)."]);
if(!flags.length) flags.push(["ok","No B.1 red flags triggered on the data entered."]);
$("redflags").innerHTML = flags.map(([t,txt])=>`<li><span class="ic ${t}">${t==="bad"?"✕":t==="warn"?"!":"✓"}</span><span>${txt}</span></li>`).join("");
// governing blend limit + actions
const lims = [...(D._oem||[]).map(o=>({...o,src:"OEM compressor rating"})), ...(D._eu||[]).map(o=>({...o,src:"end-use tolerance"}))];
let html="";
if(lims.length){
const gov = lims.reduce((a,b)=> b.lim<a.lim ? b : a);
html += `<div style="background:var(--plane);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:10px">
<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em">Governing H₂ blend limit</div>
<div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em">${gov.lim}% <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary)">by volume</span></div>
<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary)">Set by <strong>${gov.name}</strong> (${gov.src}). Individual blending limits shall be strictly respected during all blending operations.</div>
</div>`;
} else {
html += `<p style="color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px">Enter compressor OEM ratings and end-use tolerances to derive the governing blend limit.</p>`;
}
const acts=[];
if(complete && failed.length){
failed.forEach(k=> acts.push(`Raise <strong>${PNAMES[k]}</strong> to ≥ 4.00 — currently ${S[k].toFixed(2)}. ${remedy(k)}`));
acts.push("Re-screen the section after remediation. Until every parameter clears 4.00, the section is not a candidate for pilot blending regardless of the weighted total.");
} else if(complete){
acts.push(r_action(total));
acts.push("Register the segment in the national Installed-Base Readiness Registry with component OEM blend limits, and pass the data pack to B.4 (pilot selection), B.2 (acceptance standards) and B.8 (deblending offshoot nodes).");
}
if(acts.length) html += "<ol style='padding-left:18px;margin:0'>"+acts.map(a=>`<li style="margin-bottom:6px">${a}</li>`).join("")+"</ol>";
$("actions").innerHTML = html;
}
function r_action(total){
const r = rating(total);
if(r.key==="excellent") return "Rated <strong>Excellent</strong> — prioritise for pilot blending without retrofitting.";
if(r.key==="good") return "Rated <strong>Good</strong> — prioritise for pilot blending; complete the identified minor retro-fitment first.";
if(r.key==="fair") return "Rated <strong>Fair</strong> — schedule targeted upgrades (moderate retro-fitment) before blending.";
return "Rated <strong>Marginal</strong> — extensive mitigation required; treat as a second-tier candidate.";
}
function remedy(k){
return ({
mat:"Grade is fixed for an existing line — this generally means section replacement or exclusion rather than repair.",
weld:"Recover girth-weld records, run PAUT sampling, and cut out / re-weld hard or flawed joints (target ≤250 HV).",
comp:"Replace or OEM-requalify the governing valve or compressor for hydrogen blend service.",
eu:"Requalify or replace the least tolerant downstream equipment, or reduce the blend to its limit.",
age:"Vintage cannot be changed — offset with enhanced inspection and a fitness-for-service assessment, or select an alternative section.",
loss:"Run a leak survey, repair fittings and seals, and re-measure UFG before re-screening.",
loc:"Re-route, re-section to exclude Class 3/4 stretches, or apply enhanced safety measures and field-validate the class.",
corr:"Remediate active corrosion (CP review, coating repair), and re-run ILI to confirm rate and residual thickness.",
cap:"De-rate flow or reduce operating pressure to open up throughput and MAOP margin."
})[k] || "";
}
/* ============================================================
IO
============================================================ */
function collect(){
return {
meta:{op:$("op").value, plname:$("plname").value, secid:$("secid").value,
chFrom:$("chFrom").value, chTo:$("chTo").value, dia:$("dia").value, systype:$("systype").value},
modes:{...modes},
mat:{steelGrade:$("steelGrade").value, peGrade:$("peGrade").value},
weld:{hv:$("hv").value, flaw:$("flaw").value, accCode:$("accCode").value, ndt:$("ndt").value},
valves: readItems("valveList").map(v=>({tag:v.tag,body:v.body,age:v.age})),
comps: readItems("compList").map(c=>({tag:c.tag,blend:c.blend,age:c.age})),
eus: readItems("euList").map(e=>({name:e.name,limit:e.limit})),
age:$("age").value, commYr:$("commYr").value, loss:$("loss").value,
loc:{L1:$("L1").value,L2:$("L2").value,L3:$("L3").value,L4:$("L4").value},
corr:{corrRate:$("corrRate").value, rtr:$("rtr").value},
cap:{cap:$("cap").value, opm:$("opm").value, maop:$("maop").value, oppr:$("oppr").value}
};
}
function apply(d){
resetAll(true);
const m=d.meta||{}; ["op","plname","secid","chFrom","chTo","dia","systype"].forEach(k=>{ if($(k)&&m[k]!==undefined) $(k).value=m[k]; });
if(d.modes){
[...$("seg-mat").children].forEach(b=>{ if(b.dataset.v===d.modes.mat) segSet("mat",b); });
[...$("seg-weld").children].forEach(b=>{ if(b.dataset.v===d.modes.weld) segSet("weld",b); });
}
$("steelGrade").value=d.mat?.steelGrade||""; $("peGrade").value=d.mat?.peGrade||"";
["hv","flaw","accCode","ndt"].forEach(k=>{ if(d.weld&&d.weld[k]!==undefined) $(k).value=d.weld[k]; });
(d.valves||[]).forEach(addValve); (d.comps||[]).forEach(addComp); (d.eus||[]).forEach(addEU);
$("age").value=d.age||""; $("commYr").value=d.commYr||""; $("loss").value=d.loss||"";
["L1","L2","L3","L4"].forEach(k=>{ if(d.loc&&d.loc[k]!==undefined) $(k).value=d.loc[k]; });
["corrRate","rtr"].forEach(k=>{ if(d.corr&&d.corr[k]!==undefined) $(k).value=d.corr[k]; });
["cap","opm","maop","oppr"].forEach(k=>{ if(d.cap&&d.cap[k]!==undefined) $(k).value=d.cap[k]; });
calc();
}
function saveJSON(){
const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(collect(),null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
dl(blob, ($("secid").value||"segment")+"_B1_inputs.json");
}
function loadJSON(ev){
const f=ev.target.files[0]; if(!f) return;
const rd=new FileReader();
rd.onload=e=>{ try{ apply(JSON.parse(e.target.result)); }catch(err){ alert("Could not read that file: "+err.message); } };
rd.readAsText(f); ev.target.value="";
}
function exportCSV(){
if(!LAST) return;
const {S,total,complete,failed} = LAST;
const r = rating(total);
const head=["Operator","Pipeline","Section","From_km","To_km","Size_in","System",
...Object.keys(WEIGHTS).map(k=>PNAMES[k].replace(/,/g,"")),
"Total_Score","Rating","Gate_Pass","Failed_Parameters","Action"];
const row=[$("op").value,$("plname").value,$("secid").value,$("chFrom").value,$("chTo").value,$("dia").value,$("systype").value,
...Object.keys(WEIGHTS).map(k=>S[k]===null?"":S[k].toFixed(2)),
complete?total.toFixed(3):"", complete?r.label:"INCOMPLETE",
complete?(failed.length?"FAIL":"PASS"):"", failed.map(k=>PNAMES[k]).join("; "),
complete?(failed.length?"Not suitable as-is — fails minimum-score gate":r.action):""];
const csv=[head,row].map(a=>a.map(x=>`"${String(x??"").replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(",")).join("\n");
dl(new Blob([csv],{type:"text/csv"}), ($("secid").value||"segment")+"_B1_result.csv");
}
function dl(blob,name){
const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download=name; a.click();
setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);
}
function resetAll(silent){
document.querySelectorAll("input[type=number],input[type=text]").forEach(i=>i.value="");
document.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(s=>{ if(s.id!=="systype") s.value=""; });
$("valveList").innerHTML=""; $("compList").innerHTML=""; $("euList").innerHTML="";
if(!silent) calc();
}
function loadExample(){
apply({
meta:{op:"GSPC", plname:"Sanand GIDC Connectivity", secid:"SEC-02/A", chFrom:"0.00", chTo:"4.50", dia:"8", systype:"NGPL"},
modes:{mat:"steel", weld:"primary"},
mat:{steelGrade:"X42", peGrade:""},
weld:{hv:"212", flaw:"0.8", accCode:"", ndt:""},
valves:[{tag:"SV-101", body:"ss316", age:6},{tag:"BV-104", body:"ss316", age:4}],
comps:[{tag:"CS-01 K-101", blend:12, age:7}],
eus:[{name:"Industrial burner — GACL", limit:12},{name:"Boiler house", limit:15}],
age:"9", commYr:"", loss:"0.22",
loc:{L1:"4.10", L2:"0.40", L3:"0", L4:"0"},
corr:{corrRate:"0.12", rtr:"0.97"},
cap:{cap:"86", opm:"58", maop:"", oppr:""}
});
}
function toggleTheme(){
const d = document.documentElement.dataset.theme==="dark";
document.documentElement.dataset.theme = d?"light":"dark";
$("themeBtn").textContent = d?"Dark":"Light";
}
/* ---------- reference tables ---------- */
function refTable(title, head, rows){
return `<h4 class="rt">${title}</h4><table class="ref"><thead><tr>${head.map(h=>`<th>${h}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>`
+ rows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map((c,i)=>`<td class="${i===r.length-1?"n":""}">${c}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")
+ `</tbody></table>`;
}
$("refTables").innerHTML =
refTable("Table 19 — Weightings", ["Parameter","Weight"], Object.keys(WEIGHTS).map(k=>[PNAMES[k],(WEIGHTS[k]*100).toFixed(0)+"%"]))
+ refTable("Table 20 — Evaluation", ["Total score","Rating","Action"],
